gold_note: Strict consensus with two large fans: a 24-way node (19 tips, two pairs, Gongpoquansaurus and the hadrosauroid node, stem entering at Proa's height) and a 12-way hadrosauroid node (11 tips and the Tanius node). Further: a five-way node (four tips and Hadrosauridae's sister group). No clade names are printed. 47 tips, 3 polytomies (23, 12, 5 children). Sample 4 case (census 2, seed 20261201). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
